response.sql:
SELECT f.original_language_id,
       AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM film AS f
WHERE f.replacement_cost <= 20.99
GROUP BY f.original_language_id
ORDER BY film_count DESC, f.original_language_id
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff” means include films whose replacement_cost is at most 20.99.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff means strictly below 20.99, exclude films priced exactly at the cutoff.
